rationale: The construction is scale-inconsistent — a single z-score of profit change is differenced against a two-z-score composite with roughly √2 the dispersion, so the "payoff spread" will be dominated by the lagged excess-accrual term and largely reproduces the archived excess-accrual-investment effect in linear form rather than testing a genuine payoff comparison.

The two coverage ratios are both monotone transforms of cash relative to a liability class and share `che` in numerator and denominator, so they are highly collinear; the MIN adds little beyond the already-archived Cash-Covered Financing Claims (alpha 0.044, t=4.58) and amounts to a mechanical restacking of two prior winners.

The intersection of two economically distinct archived components (own-history depreciation intensity and financing-claim cash coverage) with pretax profitability is coherent and the sign direction is internally consistent, though TS_RANK(dpc/at) may proxy for recent impairments or capex cycles rather than a clean capital-consumption stress test, and the value-add over the parents is incremental.

This is a triple-MIN stack of two already-accepted archived signals whose second and third legs are mechanically entangled (che/act and (act−che)/revt both hinge on the cash share of current assets), so the incremental information is likely small and any gain risks coming from narrower, less stable intersection membership.

The economics (new short-term financing funding accrual-bearing operating assets before interest hits earnings) are coherent and the expected negative sign matches the MIN's natural direction, but with a negative-sign weakest-link construction only the short leg is economically identified while the long leg pools firms failing any one of three unrelated conditions.

The absolute-value penalty symmetrically punishes large negative operating working capital, which is typically a sign of strong customer/supplier financing and is empirically associated with outperformance, so the stated mechanism partly contradicts the direction of the underlying evidence and the signal closely echoes the weak-performing archived Balanced Operating-Accrual Margin.
